entries.head: logql
entries.message: logql: log query is %T (not MatchersExpr or PipelineExpr)
entries.rationale: unreachable: lower calls lowerLogQuery only from its *syntax.MatchersExpr and *syntax.PipelineExpr cases, so sel is always one of the two types the switch handles

guard: default of switch e := sel.(type) over [case *syntax.MatchersExpr; case *syntax.PipelineExpr; default]
